performance.verdict: Meta carries all 138 leads; Google and GHL pipeline are both confirmed dead weight.

findings.text: channel_dark:meta flag conflicts with data — Meta is active at $1,672 spend and 138 leads; flag likely a reporting gap, not a true blackout.
Google Ads spent $508.73 over 28 days and produced 0 conversions across 115 clicks — confirmed dead-weight spend at infinite CPL.

5 overdue SOW milestones (Stripe QA Jul 20, GHL Build Aug 31, Stack Re-Test Aug 31, Paid Landing Pages Aug 31, UGC Batch Aug 31) — none show a completed event; all are scaling or attribution blockers.
3-day lead signal (Sep 11–13): 4+0+0 = 4 leads vs prior 3 days (Sep 8–10): 10+12+6 = 28 — a sharp weekend falloff pattern, not creative fatigue; spend also drops to ~$0 on Sep 12–13.
GHL shows 137 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and 189 contacts — leads are entering the pipeline but no activation is occurring; intake leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Pause Google Ads immediately — $508.73 spent, 0 conversions over 28 days is confirmed zero-return spend.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads has spent $508.73 across 28 days and 115 clicks with zero recorded conversions — confirmed dead-weight at infinite CPL. Pause all Google campaigns now and redirect the ~$18/day to Meta where all 138 leads originate. Success check: Meta CPL holds at or below $15.80 within 7 days of the shift (by 2026-09-21). If Google conversion tracking is later confirmed broken (client-side pixel), revisit before any restart.

suggestions.text: Shift ~$18/day freed from Google pause into Meta — keep total daily spend flat at ~$82, monitor CPL ceiling.
suggestions.monday_update: Once Google campaigns are paused (S1), reallocate the ~$18/day to the top Meta campaign 'BWS - April End - Call Campaign' which holds the current $15.80 CPL. This is a like-for-like spend shift, not a budget increase. Confirm CPL stays at or below $16.50 by 2026-09-21; if it rises above that, hold the increment and flag for Sohib review.

suggestions.text: Escalate GHL pipeline intake leak — 137 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments; follow-up automation or CS action is broken.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 137 opportunities created against 189 contacts with zero appointments booked and zero won — leads are arriving but no activation is happening. This coincides with 5 overdue SOW milestones including the End-to-End Stack Re-Test (due Aug 31) and CS permissions audit. Nacer (Ops) to run the dummy deactivation test and BWS duplicate-path check this week. Success check: at least one appointment booked and confirmed in GHL by 2026-09-21, and all 5 overdue milestone items marked complete or escalated.
